label: prop:habiro-pochhammer-bridge
title: Habiro–Markov bridge via Pochhammer factorisation
html:
Let q \in \mathbb{R}_{>0}, u = \sqrt{q}, and let \{a_m(u)\}_{m=0}^{M} be the Habiro coefficients of a braid word \beta \in B_n (integer polynomials in u). Define the two Pochhammer conventions:

  (q;q)_m \;=\; \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 - q^k),
  \qquad
  (u;u)_m \;=\; \prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 - u^k).

Then 1 - q^k = (1 - u^k)(1 + u^k) for all k \geq 1, and the ratio of the two Habiro evaluations is the Habiro-weighted product:

  \frac{\sum_m a_m(u)\,(q;q)_m}{\sum_m a_m(u)\,(u;u)_m}
  \;=\;
  \Bigl\langle\prod_{k=1}^{m}(1 + u^k)\Bigr\rangle_{\!\mathrm{Hab}}

where the Habiro average is \langle f_m \rangle_{\mathrm{Hab}} = \sum_m a_m(u)\,(u;u)_m \cdot f_m \,/\, \sum_m a_m(u)\,(u;u)_m.

canonical structural verification (proton, n = 9)

At the substrate q_0 \approx 1.1100, u_0 = \sqrt{q_0} \approx 1.0536:

Quantity Value
\sum a_m\,(q;q)_m 136.071
\sum a_m\,(u;u)_m 24.227
\langle\prod(1+u^k)\rangle_{\mathrm{Hab}} 5.616
Ratio check 136.071 / 24.227 = 5.616 (confirmed)

The full bridge R_{\mathrm{alg}}(q) = \mathrm{bridge}(q) / (n!/[n]_q!) is an exact rational function of q (degree 226/97 in u). The correction S = R_{\mathrm{alg}} / (\mathrm{Vol}(4_1)/\hbar_q^2) inherits transcendental dependence on \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) and cannot be expressed as a closed-form rational function of \hbar_q^2 from representation theory alone.

The identity relies on the elementary algebraic factorization 1-q^k = (1-u^k)(1+u^k); its framework-specific content lies in the application to the Habiro-weighted-average ratio, linking standard q-series identities to the physical structure.
